units.source_text: 且说贺茂斋院因遭父丧，回宫守孝。

en.t: Now, the Kamo Saiin, having lost her father, returned to the palace to observe mourning.

units.source_text: 斋院之职便由槿姬代任。

en.t: The office of Saiin was therefore taken over by Princess Asagao.

units.source_text: 从来贺茂斋院必须由公主担当，亲王的女儿当斋院，少有其例。

en.t: Traditionally, the Kamo Saiin had to be an imperial princess; it was rare for the daughter of a prince to serve as Saiin.

units.source_text: 此次因无适当之公主可派，所以派了槿姬。

en.t: This time, because there was no suitable imperial princess to appoint, Princess Asagao was chosen.

units.source_text: 源氏爱慕槿姬，虽然多年失望，还是不能忘情，现在闻知她当了斋院，从此隔离更远，心中不免惋惜。

en.t: Genji loved Princess Asagao, and although he had been disappointed for many years, he still could not forget her; when he heard that she had become Saiin and would now be even farther beyond his reach, he could not help feeling regret.

units.source_text: 然而还是与从前一样，托槿姬的侍女中将传递音信，往还不绝。

en.t: Even so, just as before, he asked Princess Asagao's attendant Chujo to carry messages, and their correspondence did not cease.

units.source_text: 他对于自己今已失势之事，并不特别关心。

en.t: He was not especially concerned that he had now lost his influence.

units.source_text: 只管东钻西营地做此等无聊之事，借以消愁解闷。

en.t: He simply busied himself here and there with such trivial matters, using them to dispel his sorrow and relieve his boredom.
